runtimeMapping.ordinaryAttack: Character Attack, mode 1/2/3 attack prefabs, SELF selector at the original 0.4-second facing hit event, current block target cap, uncapped native animation speed. Native allowZeroBlockCntLimit=0 maps to a one-target minimum. Reviewed branch notes allow a forced own-blocked aerial target; other air is excluded.
runtimeMapping.battleaxe: gvial2_t_1 ON_OWNER_BLOCKEE_CHANGED recounts actual blocked objects, not their block weights. Base and derived ATK/DEF percentages sum with skill percentages. blocked/unblocked events cover contact, death, capacity loss and full release; the immutable build selects E1/E2 and potential.
runtimeMapping.medicalBackground: gvial2_t_2 IsHeal and GE half-HP selector scale each accepted heal; HP regeneration is not a heal. Selected E2 potential scales follow current HP at each receipt, including multiple S1 victims.
runtimeMapping.s1: Skill mode 1, selected ATK percentage and heal_via_damage per successful outgoing receipt, including separate non-attack damage. The mapping uses post-shield damage amount before overkill is clipped to remaining HP; native HealViaDamage compiled internals are not recovered.
runtimeMapping.s2: Skill mode 2 applies selected ATK/DEF and range immediately, holds attacks during original Skill_2_Begin, then uses original directional Loop/Idle/End clips. An unblocked hit emits a separate invisible fixed-destination speed-10 projectile lasting at most five seconds. Source-independent flight survives source exit and skill finish. The pull respects current target life, weight, collision and shared displacement immunity.
runtimeMapping.s3: Skill mode 3 applies selected ATK/ASPD/+2 block. Native ANY_ATTACK DamageScale at priority -3000 reserves damage_resistance of post-mitigation Phys/Arts/Pure receipts before shields. Finish converts the sum via interval/final_duration into direct PURE/NORMAL self receipts with no SP, bypassed modifier/immunity checks and ordinary fatal bookkeeping. Buff pulses precede expiry, preserving all 200 payments; removal cancels the owned debt.

verificationLimits: Modules, original skill particles, chainsaw/pull/bleed effects, native sounds and enemy abilities beyond enabled stage opponents are not implemented.

Original MUZZLE animation coordinates are not mapped to battlefield space. Pull flight starts at the saved source centre; its 0.5-tile stopping circle, fixed destination, speed and source-independent lifetime are source-backed. Native continuous pull/link motion is approximated by shared collision-aware displacement on arrival.

The pull rejects a newly blocked target on arrival because notInfluencedByBlock=0. Compiled collision/link dispatch, hitting moving targets, highland physics and muzzle-relative distances require in-game traces; preserving the fields is not native frame certification.
Native selector input inclusion and the own-blocked air exception map to shared priority/targeting rules; no compiled native C# selector trace was recovered.

HealViaDamage uses the simulator accepted post-shield receipt amount rather than remaining-HP-clipped credit. Native cancelled-modifier and overkill semantics need direct client traces despite authored notes confirming per-receipt healing.

S3 follows source ANY_ATTACK, -3000 order and direct PURE/NORMAL bleed fields. Interaction with foreign native modifier priorities and shield dispatch cannot be certified by the shared engine tests alone.

Native DEFAULT/maxStackCnt=1 bleed override maps to replacement of the prior owned bleed. Forced overlapping recasts, lifecycle ordering and exact last-pulse/expiration timing need client verification.
Combat uses the shared fixed tick, original facing hit events and uncapped animation rate. Begin/End interruption and sub-tick FSM transitions are not verified frame-for-frame against the game.

mechanicsReference.role: Authored branch and skill mechanics notes, checked against original native prefab fields; not an official client execution trace.
